rolloutFeatures.reason: the unlock enum and the patchability keys are per feature; a platform that lacks a feature is a decision, not a quiet narrowing

rolloutPatchability.<name>.unmatchedSite.reason: the patcher refuses to half-patch on its own host; the count is read per host and only the derived `patchable` bool is combined

settingKeys.reason: the flatten boundary must know every key the binary names; one TUI bundle ships to both hosts, so a delta is a decision

workspaceOverridableSettings.reason: the devenv guard refuses keys outside this set; a silently narrowed set would reject settings the host honors
